# ChangeDir

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChangeDir:Void dir:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | In | String | required | The folder to go to. |

## Description

Makes another folder the current one, which is where relative paths start. Use [CurrentDir](CurrentDir) to see where you are.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
start$ = CurrentDir$()
CreateDir "files_change_example"
ChangeDir "files_change_example"
Print FileType(start$) <> 0
ChangeDir start$
DeleteDir "files_change_example"
```

```text
1
```
